slides.headline: Run AI models locally
slides.say: Did you know you can now run AI models like DeepSeek and Gemma on your own computer? This is Day 1 of our exclusive 100-day series, finding the best GitHub repo for you.

slides.headline: What it does
slides.body: Run models like DeepSeek and Gemma on your computer
slides.say: This tool lets you run AI models like DeepSeek and Gemma right on your own computer. No cloud needed. You download it, pick a model, and start chatting.

slides.headline: How to use it
slides.body: Works on Mac, Windows, Linux; has a REST API and Python library
slides.say: It runs on Mac, Windows, and Linux. There is a simple REST API and a Python library so you can plug it into your own apps. A Docker image is also available.

slides.headline: 182,100 GitHub stars
slides.body: MIT licence · Written in Go · Since June 2023
slides.say: It has over 180 thousand stars on GitHub and uses the MIT licence. It's written in Go and it's been around since June 2023.

slides.headline: Before you start
slides.body: Read the README and licence first before using it
slides.say: Before you dive in, read the README and the licence. They explain what models are supported and any limits you should know about.

slides.headline: Save · Share · Follow
slides.body: Comment REPO for the full list
slides.say: Loved it? Save this, and send it to a friend. Follow for the next 99 repos... or you might not see us again. Comment REPO, and I'll send you the full list, with install commands and similar repos.
